learnings.title: Letter sounds
learnings.focus: Hear the sound and name of each letter.
lookFor: Hears a letter's sound
Says the letter's sound back
Names the letter
Spots the letter that makes a sound
Knows a, e, i, o, u are vowels and every word needs one
Thinks of a word that starts with a letter's sound

playgrounds.note: Hear each letter's sound and name as you trace it
Sound out the letters in each word as you trace it
Blend the letter sounds as you build the word
Listen for the sound at the start of each word

learnings.title: Trace letters
learnings.focus: Trace letter shapes and learn how each letter is formed.
lookFor: Follows the letter stroke with a finger
Starts at the right place
Traces the whole letter shape
Forms round letters with an anti-clockwise curve
Knows capital letters start names and sentences
Recognises the letter afterwards

playgrounds.note: Trace each letter shape from start to finish

learnings.title: Trace whole words
learnings.focus: Trace whole words and recognise them.
lookFor: Traces a whole word
Says the word out loud
Traces curved, round letters like c, o and g
Recognises the word again
Points to the start of the word

playgrounds.note: Trace each word from start to finish and say it out loud

learnings.title: Build words
learnings.focus: Build words letter by letter, from left to right.
lookFor: Places letters in order
Blends the sounds together
Works left to right
Builds a word without seeing the picture
Reads the finished word

playgrounds.note: Place the letters in order, left to right, to build the word

learnings.title: Strokes in letters
learnings.focus: Discover that every letter is built from a few strokes — spot the shapes, match letters that share them, and put the strokes in order.
concepts: Stroke families (lines, curves, circles, diagonals, dots)
Letter families that share a shape
Language of direction (up, down, round, back)
lookFor: Spots the straight lines, curves and circles in a letter
Names the strokes a letter is made from
Matches letters that share a shape (c, a, o all have a curve)
Puts the strokes in order to build a letter
Uses direction words — up, down, round, back

playgrounds.note: Spot the strokes in each letter, match letters by shape, and tap the strokes in order

learnings.title: Rhyming words
learnings.focus: Listen for words that rhyme and sound alike.
lookFor: Spots two words that rhyme
Says a word that rhymes
Hears the end sound in a word
Joins in with a rhyme

playgrounds.note: Listen for words that rhyme and say one back

learnings.title: Understand a story
learnings.focus: Listen to a story, follow the words as they light up, and talk about what happens.
lookFor: Predicts what happens next
Recalls what happened in the story
Taps a new word to hear it and learn what it means
Follows the highlighted words left to right
Says how a character felt

playgrounds.note: Listen and follow the words, then talk about what happens and how characters feel
